## RX-TX-Tracker v2.0.40

### Release summary
- Added a dedicated QA smoke check for the 90-day Needs Action workflow flow from `npm run qa:web`.
- New task seeds an expired, incomplete RX cycle and validates the needs-action filter, banner, and filtered patient row rendering.

### What’s included
- `qa/smoke-qa.js` (needs-action fixture/seeding + verification flow)
- `qa/web-ui.js` (new dashboard task)

- `qa/README.md` (release note on optional validation)
- `qa/QA-WEB-MANUAL.md` (validation checklist details)
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `package.json`
- `OPERATIONS_MANUAL.md`
- `dist/server-update-2.0.40.zip`
